title: 🔥Risk_off下的资产背离
body: 市场处于宏观风险规避期。BMRI 指数仅为 75（RISK_OFF），表明大环境风险偏好极低。但 BTC 价格逆势上涨 4.9% 至 $65,490，与宏观情绪背离，证明当前抛压已极度衰竭。估值底部支撑对抗宏观逆风，变盘仅缺流动性信号。中性。宏观转机何时出现？
body_en: The market is in a macro risk-aversion phase. The BMRI index sits at a mere 75 (RISK_OFF), signaling extremely low risk appetite in the broader environment. However, BTC defied the odds, rallying 4.9% to $65,490. This divergence from macro sentiment proves that sell-side pressure is completely exhausted. Valuation bottoms are holding up against macro headwinds; a pivot is just missing the liquidity signal. Neutral. When will the macro shift hit?
